v.trickster.look.text: This word is a tricky one. Look closely at the underlined part.

v.trickster.arm.1.text: Stand up and hold one arm out in front of you.

v.trickster.arm.2.text: Tap down your arm, one tap for each letter, and say each letter as you tap.

v.trickster.arm.3.text: Now slide your hand down your arm and say the whole word.

v.trickster.arm.4.text: Say the word once more. Think about the tricky part.

v.trickster.nice.text: Nice tracing. Press Next when you are ready to read it.

v.trickster.read.text: Now read the word out loud.
